speech.heard: USA has 100% basic drinking water access. In Dr. Congo, it's 36%. Dr. Congo is the world's lowest. This counts improved sources within a 30-minute round trip. USA has 2.8 times the access of Dr. Congo. India and China both have 96%. At the bottom, Central African Republic 37%, South Sudan 40% and Burkina Faso 50%. Nigeria has 82%, Pakistan has 91%, Brazil has 100%, one of the highest in the world. Where does your country land?
